summary: Iteration 3 — validation of the axios 401 silent-refresh bugfix (/app/frontend/src/lib/api.js). Backend: 31/31 pytest passing (added new suite test_token_refresh.py with 9 tests pinning the /api/auth/refresh contract; fixed one stale assertion in backend_test.py). Frontend E2E with forged cookies (expired access_token + valid refresh_token injected via Playwright add_cookies): (1) Dashboard reload -> 2 concurrent /auth/me 401s -> EXACTLY ONE POST /auth/refresh (200) -> /auth/me, /hub/dashboard/stats and /hub/dashboard/activity all 200, KPIs 2/2/5/5 rendered, no 401 visible to the user. (2) 'Abrir módulo' (open-orders) with expired access -> launch-token 401 -> 1 refresh -> launch-token retried 200 -> window.open URL contains ?handoff= with a 3-part JWT (role=admin, restaurant_id/slug server-signed); exactly 2 launch-token calls (anti-loop _retried honored). (3) Wrong password -> 'E-mail ou senha inválidos' in data-testid=login-error, ZERO /auth/refresh calls, stays on /login. (4) Both tokens invalid -> redirected to /login, no infinite loop (3 sequential refresh 401s total, bounded). (5) Logout -> POST /auth/logout 200, redirect to /login, no refresh attempt. (6) Regression with real login: dashboard KPIs, 5 client rows, 6 module catalog cards all OK. The reported bug is FIXED.

integration_issues.issue: MINOR / non-blocking deviation from the stated expectation: the interceptor does NOT exclude /auth/me, so a logged-out visitor's initial GET /api/auth/me 401 fires an extra POST /api/auth/refresh that always returns 401 (observed 1 refresh per guest load on /login). No loop, no UX impact (window.location redirect is skipped on /login and ProtectedRoute handles the rest), but it adds a wasted failing request on every guest visit and shows a 401 in the console. Suggested fix: treat /auth/me as a 'probe' (add to AUTH_PATHS or pass a flag/skipRefresh config from AuthContext's bootstrap call).

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): skip the refresh attempt for the AuthContext bootstrap /auth/me call so logged-out visitors don't trigger a guaranteed-failing POST /auth/refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor is correct: single-flight refreshPromise + per-request _retried flag prevents both refresh storms and retry chains — verified empirically (1 refresh for 2 concurrent 401s; max 2 attempts per original request).

Note: single-flight only dedupes strictly concurrent 401s; sequential 401s after a failed refresh still issue new refresh calls (3 observed in the unrecoverable-session run before the full-page redirect). Bounded and acceptable, but a short-lived 'refresh failed' latch would make it 1.
Access token TTL remains 60min (server.py:90) by design; the frontend now recovers silently, so no backend change needed.

To reproduce the expired-session flow in Playwright: context.clear_cookies() then add_cookies([access_token=<forged expired>, refresh_token=<forged valid>], domain=module-control-2.preview.emergentagent.com, path='/', secure=True, sameSite='None'). rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: 60-minute access_token expiry with no client-side refresh — every authenticated XHR returned 401 'Token expirado' while the React UI still believed the user was logged in. The applied frontend-only fix (axios response interceptor with single-flight refresh, _retried anti-loop guard and full-page redirect on unrecoverable refresh failure) was reproduced and verified end-to-end and resolves the issue; no backend change required.
